items.title: 1-Click GitHub Token Stealing via a VSCode Bug
items.whyItMatters: VSCode extension bug lets a malicious extension steal GitHub tokens — a practical reminder to audit extension permissions before installing.

items.title: Use your Nvidia GPU's VRAM as swap space on Linux
items.whyItMatters: Uses a block device to swap into GPU VRAM on Linux — useful when running multiple large models and RAM is available but VRAM is not.

items.title: AI Agent Guidelines for CS336 at Stanford
items.whyItMatters: Stanford's new AI Agent course gives a real framework prompt for Claude Code — useful reference for building agentic workflows.

items.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
items.whyItMatters: OpenAI frontier models and Codex on AWS means lower-latency inference for teams already on AWS, plus Codex as a hosted agent runtime.

items.title: Malicious npm packages detected across Red Hat Cloud Services
items.whyItMatters: Malicious npm packages found in Red Hat Cloud Services supply chain — a reminder that even trusted registries can be compromised.
